messages:
inc-bot: [ALERT] Pager triggered for Galatea (enterprise-vpc) — increased 5xx rate on dedicated-galatea-pool. Pager: sev=2. Started 2026-03-17T09:04:31Z
sara: ping @oncall-ml @ops-ryan — seeing eviction storms and KV cache churn for Galatea tenant. latency + p50 -> 420ms, 5xx ~3.2% (baseline 0.1%).
oncall-ml: on it. grabbing logs and current routing map. can someone confirm if dedicated-galatea-pool autoscale hit max?
infra-kim: autoscale at 100% of reserved. No new GPUs available in region. eviction_count spike correlated with long seq requests from galatea-prod.
mike: leaning toward temporary tenant isolation + pin to safe variant. suggest: 1) route Galatea to a lower-memory safe variant (galatea-lite-qd4), 2) pin model version, 3) enable "armor-fallback" (rate-limited fallback) while we stabilize.
jillian: +1. account-liz — do we need to notify customer immediately or wait until we have a mitigation in place?
account-liz: notify now with "we're aware and applying mitigations; may see transient consistency differences while we pin to a safe variant." I'll draft and send after ops confirms.
ops-ryan: executing plan. running pin and routing change now.
ops-ryan: command run:
```
redwoodctl override set --tenant galatea --model galatea-large --pin-version v2.1.0 --safe-variant galatea-lite-qd4 --reason "eviction storm"
redwoodctl route update --tenant galatea --policy="route_to_safe_variant: true; armor_fallback:true; rate_limit:50r/s"
```
sara: seeing config change applied — 200ms drop on p50, 5xx down to 0.6%.
oncall-ml: monitoring KV metrics. KV cache hit% up slightly after pin. still watching spike windows. keeping isolation for 30m and then reassess.
infra-kim: added temporary capacity hold request to infra (low-latency queue). ETA ~12m.
account-liz: customer message sent: "We're applying a temporary safe model variant and routing to ensure availability; may be slight differences in generation length/quality. Will update in 30 minutes." (sent via secure channel)
mike: quick note: logged mitigation in incident tracker -> tag: galatea, mitigation: variant-pin + armor-fallback, rollback: remove pin when KV stable for 15m and 5xx<0.2%
jillian: handoff to night oncall in 40m — @oncall-ml please include rollback checklist in postmortem.
oncall-ml: will do. adding steps:
- verify 5xx < 0.2% for 15min
- run regression prompts vs pre-change eval set
- if fail, escalate to model-team and consider canary traffic to other region
sara: ephemeral note: saved kernel logs -> /var/logs/galatea/eviction-20260317.log
inc-bot: [UPDATE] Pager status changed to mitigated by ops at 2026-03-17T09:27:03Z (owner: ops-ryan). Please continue monitoring.
account-liz: customer replied: "Thanks — we appreciate the quick action. We'll test and report any anomalies." :thumbsup: 
oncall-ml: leaving thread. handoff to @marta-night oncall. Marta — full context in incident ticket #INC-48212.
marta-night: acked. monitoring. will update if any regression.
ops-ryan: adding postmortem blurb: probable root cause = bursty long-seq traffic from Galatea app causing KV flushes and eviction + autoscale saturation. Followups: stronger per-tenant seq-limits, preemptive cache pinning, circuit-breaker at router.
sara: thanks everyone. closing working thread when metrics stable for 30m. :white_check_mark:
